description: This file defines the LoggerData interface, which specifies methods related to logging data in the RomRaider open-source tuning project. It includes method signatures for retrieving identifiers, names, descriptions, managing data convertors, and selection state.

classes.name: LoggerData
classes.description: Interface for logging data, providing method signatures for data identification, conversion, and selection management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the logger data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the logger data.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the logger data.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if the logger data is currently selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state of the logger data.
